note: A 40-second intro from the 13 Oct paper, to hear Ashu and Tarun before their first episode (14 Oct). Every fact is from that edition.

turns.speaker: Ashu
turns.text: Good afternoon, and welcome to The House of 1400. It's Tuesday, the thirteenth of October. I'm Ashu, with T. A. Bhide's paper, fresh off the press.

turns.speaker: Tarun
turns.text: And I'm Tarun. Chai is ready, and arre, what a front page today.

turns.speaker: Ashu
turns.text: Jantar Mantar was closed to protests on Monday. By Tuesday morning, Cockroach Janata Party leaders had walked in carrying the Tiranga.

turns.speaker: Ashu
turns.text: Through the food stalls right beside it. The police detained them inside.

turns.speaker: Tarun
turns.text: And money? Good news or bad for us?

turns.speaker: Ashu
turns.text: Mostly bad. Retail inflation jumped to five point five four per cent in September, the highest since October twenty twenty-four.

turns.speaker: Tarun
turns.text: But the Sensex is up about one per cent today, though it's still near its three-month low.
